claims.title: Exact initial membership endpoint, source letters and threshold indexing
claims.statement: Under DataII and C>=1, every actual symP(B_b) satisfies MemAtG(0,1/8): all plane coefficients after all compatible physical digit/degree blocks and selected normal joint projectors satisfy source XX with chain theta=thStar and link theta=thStar-slU/8. Frame indices are reversed, and the odd-predecessor normal index is u-1.

claims.title: Actual pair span, retained degree blocks and exact tensor factorization
claims.statement: The actual localizer is supported on plane vector variables. The proof holds on BlockDeg-compatible blocks of each pair-product summand, extends by multilinearity to actual symbol-space factors, and then uses physical homogeneity to eliminate incompatible blocks. A compatible low-digit block factors as A_* tensor G_*, and normal coefficient extraction after the projector is a scalar multiple of A_*.

claims.title: All selected normal prefix types inherit the original maximum-weight cutoffs
claims.statement: Canonical isotypic projectors for nested/disjoint prefixes commute. Joint-isotypic vectors span each finite-degree space, so the literal IsJProj condition determines the product projector uniquely. A nonzero selected normal vector therefore has each selected type present; its largest coordinate is bounded by the original segment normal-prefix maximum. No integral direct sum or projector-denominator estimate is used.
claims.background: Ordinary characteristic-zero complete reducibility and highest-weight extremal-weight facts, already used in v0_5 PG/IW. The report supplies the precise commutation, uniqueness, homogeneous-filtering and prefix identification argument.

claims.title: Recover every thStar term, including the odd predecessor
claims.statement: The pair inequalities and IN3 imply v_<x(A_j)>=thStar(j,u). At an odd predecessor the supported plane prefix <=previous equals <current, while the even predecessor set and hence Bo/sl are unchanged. The selected normal index is exactly u-1.

claims.title: Model-variable renaming and homogeneous filters before the power substitution
claims.statement: The model product Pi has the original chain order. Its exact plane level image is X^b phi(Pi), and extracting dP is a filter on model letter degrees before phi. This filter cannot lower generic order. No characteristic-zero equivariance is asserted for phi's positive-power substitutions.

claims.title: Exact frame-digit identity and zero chain loss
claims.statement: After expanding the independent lab variables, exact quotient/remainder arithmetic gives Fdig_sigma(X^beta phi Q)=0 or X^lift(floor(beta/P))Q for Q supported on ll,wc. The extra monomial contains only vector letters in each chain. Thus every frame-digit extraction retains the complete thStar chain bound.

claims.title: Deleting a preceding vector frame costs only its surviving degree
claims.statement: Inverse vector twisting on a degree-d_W preceding frame lowers Laurent order by at most d_W. Remaining coefficients rename into the true link. Decomposing by source letter degrees and retaining only pieces that can survive dP bounds d_W by exact dwB=Delta_j, giving link order >=thStar-Delta_j.

claims.title: Exact degree cancellation and numerical bound Delta_j<=slU/8
claims.statement: BlockDeg plus the base-monomial residues cancels the localizer degree and gives q_x(dP-deg b)_+<=G2d<=2a. Distinct previous-frame distances produce Delta_j<=3a/p^g with no factor r. The oldest-vector separation and actual size hypotheses give D+L1+1<=g, 48Yk^2<=p^(L1+1), and 1<=Bo/(Yk^2)<=2 floor(Bo/(Yk^2)); hence Delta_j<=slU/8. C>=1 suffices; J>=2 is also derived.

claims.title: Assemble the actual symbols into Lemma5aAt and expose the WT interface
claims.statement: Combine IN2--IN8 on compatible blocks, extend over the defining pair spans, eliminate incompatible blocks using actual physical homogeneity, and sum the actual SPR monomials. Every symP(B_b) and their Kf-linear span satisfy MemAtG(0,1/8). WT then supplies MemAtG(1/8,3/8)=MemAt. No stronger arbitrary unblocked generator-product theorem is claimed.
